  olean : D:/lean/.lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1854CoherentCategoryActual.olean (337248 bytes, 07:31:59)
  cmd   : lake env lean -j1 -R . -o <olean> tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1854CoherentCategoryActual.lean   -> EXIT=0
  imports the olean cleanly in a separate consumer probe (EXIT=0).  Axioms of every audited
  declaration: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only; zero sorryAx.  Imports S1852, S1809,
  S1828, S1762, S1833, S1832.

WHAT IS PROVED (CoherentCover = S1852's strong cover + S1756 unit)
1. S1854Compatible (compatibility of an S1728 cover map f : A.cover -> B.cover with the strong
   presentations): exists g : model A -> model B with  f vcomp lift_B = lift_A vcomp g (2-iso),
   where lift is the unconditional identity-point S1743 lift.  2-iso invariant
   (S1854Compatible_of_rel).
2. S1854Compatible_of_map: EVERY cover map between coherent covers is compatible (proof: cancel the
   unconditional counit lift vcomp toSource = 1).  So the forgetful map on 2-iso classes is a
   bijection; this is proved, not assumed.
3. S1854CoherentMap / S1854CoherentQuot (2-iso quotient of compatible maps) and the bijection
   S1854QuotEquiv : CoherentQuot A B = S1728CoverMapClass A.cover B.cover (surjective via Quot.out,
   injective via Quot.eqvGen_exact + S1809EqvGen_to_rel).
4. S1854CategoryOfHomEquivOn: transport of a category along hom equivalences for a forgetful object
   map, with the two hom universes independent (generalises S1728CategoryOfHomEquiv; laws proved by
   injectivity of the equivalence).
5. S1854CoherentCategory11 : Category.{1,1} CoherentCover with Hom = 2-iso classes of compatible
   maps (transported S1728ActualCategory11: real id/comp, no fake laws).
6. S1854Forget11 : CoherentCover -> S1728Cover; instances S1854Forget11_full and
   S1854Forget11_faithful, plus S1854Forget11_map_bijective (Bijective on 2-iso classes).
7. S1854CoherentCategory01 : Category.{0,1} CoherentCover (homs = S1766 Type-0 small carrier of the
   underlying covers) and S1854Forget01 : -> S1809CoverCategory01, Full + Faithful + hom bijective.
8. Terminal (unconditional, both universes): S1854StrongOfS1762 (strong structure on
   S1762TerminalCover.map with the SAME weak presentations; coneEssSurj from S1852IdStrongBc),
   S1854TerminalCoherent with S1854TerminalCover_eq : cover = S1762TerminalCover (rfl),
   S1854TerminalCoherent_isTerminal, S1854HasTerminal, S1854TerminalCoherent01_isTerminal,
   S1854HasTerminal01; also S1854TerminalEnd (S1756End = id for it).
9. S1828 R1 transport: S1854ModelSliceCategory : Category.{0,1} CoherentCover with Hom :=
   S1812ModelHomOver A.cover B.cover; S1854ModelSliceForget : -> S1828ModelOverCategory, Full +
   Faithful; S1854SliceHomEquiv : S1812ModelHomOver A.cover B.cover = S1854CoherentMap A B (from
   S1828SliceHomEquiv); S1854CoherentR1_modelSlice : S1854CoherentR1 (the coherent analogue of
   S1754StrictHomEquiv, id/comp compatibility included) from the SAME two hypotheses as S1828:
   S1755SourceRetraction + S1766CoverMapDiscrete.
10. S1832/S1833: PRECISE FIRST MISSING (no inhabitant asserted, not proved):
   - S1854PullbackApexCoherent (h : HasPullbacks S1728Cover): every chosen pullback apex of a
     cospan of underlying coherent covers is itself the underlying cover of a coherent cover.
   - S1854CoproductApexCoherent (h0, h2): the chosen initial and binary-coproduct apexes are
     coherent.
   - S1854PullbackTransport / S1854CoproductTransport: the transport statements themselves
     (S1728 limit/coproduct structure + apex coherence => same on the coherent category).
   - S1854PullbackFirstMissing := S1832FirstMissingPullback /\ S1854PullbackTransport;
     S1854CoproductFirstMissing := S1833FirstMissing /\ S1854CoproductTransport;
     S1854LimitsFirstMissing := both.

HONEST BOUNDARY
- The compatibility predicate is proved automatic, so the coherent category is the FULL
  subcategory of the S1728 2-iso category on the coherent covers: the coherent (strong) datum
  restricts OBJECTS, not HOMS.  Stated as a theorem, so full/faithful is not vacuous.
- The terminal object and S1828's R1 are transported unconditionally (given S1828's own two
  hypotheses for R1).  The pullback and finite-coproduct transports are NOT proved; they are
  recorded as the named Props above.  No new axiom, no fake category, no sorry.

NEXT EXECUTABLE STEP
Prove S1854PullbackTransport and S1854CoproductTransport: elementary (a full+faithful functor
reflects the limit/coproduct cones once the apex is in the image) and independent of geometry; the
only geometric input is the apex coherence.  With S1833FirstMissing for the S1728 side, the
coherent finite coproducts then reduce to apex coherence alone.

Note: I did not touch coord/STATE.md, coord/queue.md or AUDIT_LEDGER.md (left to you to integrate;
this package's exact evidence is the SHA/EXIT/olean above).
